description.value: The View Hotel is a 62-room property opened in 2013 on the shores of Stuart Lake in Fort St. James, described on its own website as the first and only hotel in the area. Rooms range from classic queens to spacious kitchenette suites with lake views, and the hotel sits within minutes of Fort St. James National Historic Site and the Murray Ridge Ski Area. An on-site restaurant and pet-friendly policy make it a practical full-service stop for touring cyclists moving through Central BC's Cariboo-Chilcotin corridor.

address.value: 309 Stuart Drive West, Fort St. James, BC V0J 1P0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully fetched and corroborates all OSM contact details (address, phone, email). The site consistently describes a 62-room hotel with free WiFi throughout, an on-site restaurant, and pet-friendly rooms, but contains no mention of bike storage, bike-handling staff procedures, laundry, e-bike charging, tools, or any cyclist-specific amenities — those fields default to null. One minor concern: the contact subpage's HTML title reads '34 Room Hotel' while the body text throughout the site consistently says 62 rooms, suggesting a stale page title.
concerns: The HTML page title of the contact subpage reads '34 Room Hotel' while the body text throughout the entire website consistently states 62 rooms — likely a stale page title, but worth noting as a minor data inconsistency.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating hotel with an active booking system and corroborated contact details; a clear and useful overnight stop for touring cyclists in Fort St. James.
